maya: Quick heads-up — SpectralReach wants a short perf POC before signature. Scope: chat (1k ctx) streaming + embeddings ingest. They care about p95 streaming token latency and predictable 3-min microbursts. Can eng/ops propose a compact runbook + rough committed+burst cost?
kevin: clarifying Qs: target model (13B quant) and target p95? sustained qps and burst qps? embeddings qps?
maya: yes 13B quant. target p95 <= 320ms token-stream. sustained 50 qps, bursts to 220 qps for up to 3 minutes, embeddings 900 reqs/min, 512-d vectors.
arjun: propose 3-phase runbook: smoke, steady-state warmup, burst stress. use their sample prompts (avg prompt 130 tokens, gen 220). include cold-start and cache-eviction test.
kevin: runbook draft:
```
phase A: smoke 5m @ 1-3 qps (auth + payload check)
phase B: warmup 20m stepping to 50 qps (populate KV/prefix cache)
phase C: burst stress 4 cycles 3m @ 220 qps with 5m cool-downs
extras: cold-start test (restart pod, 10 concurrent requests)
metrics: p50/p95/p99 token latency, tokens/sec, gpu_util, queue_depth, 5xx rate
```
arjun: loadgen: vegeta for non-stream + small SSE harness for streaming. example: `curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream`
infra-bot: provision: dedicated/poc-spectralreach -> queued at 2024-09-05T10:12:00Z 
kevin: infra sketch: sustained 50 qps ~ 2 A100-eq GPUs (round to 2 committed units). bursts to 220 qps -> +3 pre-warmed GPUs. Back-of-envelope pricing: commit 2 units ~$45k/month. burst burn ~ $130/hr per GPU * 3 = $390/hr while active. Will refine after profile.
olivia: security note: they require customer KMS + VPC peering and audit logs. For POC we can use temporary key and capture logs; need their security contact and DPA signed.
maya: timeline: smoke + warmup tomorrow 08:30 PT, deliver CSV and 1-paragraph exec summary within 36h. Action owners: arjun (loadgen + payloads), kevin (infra + cost), olivia (security checklist). SpectralReach - please share security contact in-thread.
olivia: I'll follow up for temporary KMS key creation and add checklist items.
maya: thanks — I'll compile results into CRM record after run. :white_check_mark:
